high_risk_distinctions: Counter Reading vs Metres Produced This Shift
Fabric Quality vs Market Run vs Party Order
Metres Sold vs Metres Sent vs Metres Received
Sale vs Dispatch vs Party Receipt Confirmation
Upaad vs Kharchi vs Hisaab payout vs Inam vs Kapaat
Production Cost vs Break-even Price vs Suggested Selling Price

priority_helpers.workerHisaab: Payroll close showing earnings, Upaad recovery, adjustments, net payout, and carry-forward.
priority_helpers.upaad: Recoverable worker advance; it is not Kharchi or a Hisaab payout.
priority_helpers.kharchi: Supervisor-float cash entry; it is not automatically a worker advance or wage payment.
priority_helpers.inam: Approved bonus added to Worker Hisaab.
priority_helpers.kapaat: Approved deduction with a reason; shown separately from Upaad recovery.
priority_helpers.taka: Provisional name for one physical fabric unit; confirm the factory meaning during the pilot.
priority_helpers.warpWeft: Warp Yarn runs lengthwise; Weft Yarn runs across the fabric. Confirm local terms during the pilot.
priority_helpers.fabricQuality: The fabric construction/specification, not a grade, Market Run, or Party Order.
